pm_is_active.meaning: PM (HyperLiquid prime broker) is active when executeHedge is called

blp_reserve_exists.meaning: an active BLP reserve exists for the spot asset token being hedged

accounting_reads_revert.meaning: accounting reads (surplus, distributableSurplus, settleDailyPnL gate 3) revert, bricking accounting and yield settlement

assumptions: executeHedge is the operation that buys the spot asset and registers it in vaultSupplied via notifyVaultSupply
Recovery requires an operator to call removeSuppliedEntry to remove the bad registry entry

unresolved.description: Report does not assert the bought spot asset always lacks a BLP reserve; the missing-reserve scenario is conditional, so the condition encodes the conditional subcase

limitations: Formalizes only the accounting_bricked impact; the intermediate suppliedBalance revert is treated as mechanism, not the selected effect
Condition is narrowed to the report's conditional no-reserve scenario rather than a universally quantified absence of reserves
